# Yashashwi Singhania

> The official portfolio of Yashashwi Singhania, creator of Arras and an IIT (BHU) dual-degree student building native macOS apps, systems software and reinforcement-learning projects.

## Portfolio
- [Selected work](https://yashashwi.me/#work): Projects, source repositories, experience, and achievements.
- [Curriculum vitae](https://cv.yashashwi.me/): Education, experience, and technical skills.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/yashashwi-s): Public source repositories and contributions.

## Featured Project: Arras
- [Arras desktop photo widgets for Mac](https://tryarras.tech/): The portfolio's primary project. Uncropped photos, editable collages, slideshows, placement layers, linked Photos albums and folders, GIF/APNG and muted video widgets, reference tools and saved desktop setups.
- [Arras Widgets on the Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6824271927): One-time US$4.99 purchase; local prices may vary. Buying supports independent development. Apple manages updates, the app is sandboxed, and this edition sends no Arras usage statistics. The free direct download remains available.
- [Arras support](https://tryarras.tech/support): Setup, library migration and purchase help from the developer.
- [Arras source and GitHub stars](https://github.com/yashashwi-s/Arras): MIT-licensed source, release history and the repository's Star action.
